findings.message: AudioBank._ready() awaited one process frame before constructing MusicPlayer and VoicePlayer. LauncherOverlay calls AudioBank.play_music() during that gap, producing an invalid assignment on Nil and leaving the demo without background music or trailer voices. Audio setup must be synchronous or public methods must defer safely.

acceptance_criteria.audio_buses_levels_and_blocking_cues_che: FAIL before remediation: launcher startup produces a Nil AudioStreamPlayer error, preventing music and voice playback.
